title: sos_origin: upstream AddrForKey pinned-vector oracle test skipped in no-alloc builds
description: Security-pass finding on 1k6n fix (commit 26f158b4c9). origin_addr_matches_upstream_pinned_vector (sos_origin.rs:321) is cfg(feature="alloc")-gated, but the function it tests, origin_addr_from_pubkey (:96), is ungated — the test is gated only because its helper hex_to_bytes (:244) is alloc-gated. domain_matches_vector demonstrates the pattern: std::vec::Vec resolves under cfg(test) without the alloc feature (lib.rs:127 cfg(any(test, std)) extern crate std). Fix: rewrite hex_to_bytes with std::vec::Vec (ungated), drop the alloc gate from the vector test so the pinned upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey byte-equality oracle (project-designated independent conformance oracle) runs in no-alloc test configurations too. Default-feature runs currently silently skip the only in-file upstream-address check.
